body.x: Eight companies supported by Korea Institute of Startup & Entrepreneurship Development (KISED) participated in ‘2017 Korea Electronics Show(KES)’ held in Samsung-Dong COEX during four days from Oct. 17 (Tuesday) to Oct. 20 (Friday) displaying various products.

KISED supports discovery and development of new startups, idea commercialization, global entry of startup enterprises, and re-start-up. It also provides funding, manpower, and sales channels, etc. as well as relevant information for start-ups.
Those 8 companies are WikiBox, Suntec, Droneprosafe, NVillage, S3D, KELab Corporation, All About Wear, and Ez Counter System.
(Description: WikiBox introduced a unmanned courier box that opens and closes with a smartphone.)
(Description: Suntec presented a tritan bottle with burdock tea.)
(Description: KELab Corporation presented smart battery system.)
(Description: Ez Counter System showed unmanned counter.)

Meanwhile, KES 2017, hosted by Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Energy and sponsored by KEA (Korea Electronics Association), is an international show where lots of potential buyers, governments, group officials participate, providing a good place to experience world first products like mobile phone, semiconductor, display, and next generation convergence solutions like industrial convergence, IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education and e health.
